name: Bernard Whakatutu
source:
MBTI: ESTJ

"Relation by blood, yeah. But hey, I don't intend to hurt anyone here. As long as business doesn't call for it, I'm pretty much harmless."

The solemn mafioso who only intends to play by the rules. Bernard, even though it may cause others to doubt his understanding of the situation, always strives to maintain communication and teamwork between the group. Claiming his last vivid memory was only returning home after an assignment, Bernard admits he knows nothing about their whereabouts. Understanding why he may come off as intimidating, Bernard swears he wouldn't hurt anyone outside of obligation.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
